title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our Al-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.

  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.

  • Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactive and detail‑oriented IT Procurement Administrator to support the IT department in managing third‑party vendors, ensuring compliance with IT standards, and driving operational efficiency. This role is pivotal in maintaining strong supplier relationships, overseeing risk and compliance processes, and supporting IT procurement initiatives across the business.

The post holder will work alongside global colleagues in supporting the business and would be expected to work across multiple time zones, on a per‑project basis. This position provides exposure to a broad range of IT‑related projects and activities, and new technology introductions to the business.

Key Roles, Tasks and Responsibilities

Vendor Management

  • Manage relationships with third‑party vendors delivering core IT solutions to Airswift.
  • Oversee the supplier onboarding process.
  • Ensure vendor compliance with contractual obligations and agreed SLAs.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to identify cost savings and eliminate inefficiencies.
  • Proactively monitor contract expiry dates to ensure timely re‑negotiation and renewals.

Procurement & Budget Management

  • Develop and implement streamlined procurement processes for technology expenditure, ensuring consistent management of both new and renewal spending.
  • Manage supplier costs in line with the IT budget and ensure transparency for cross‑charging business units for usage.
  • Handle contract renewals for key IT services, ensuring cost‑effective and aligned solutions.

Vendor Risk & Compliance

  • Identify and elevate potential risks in service delivery, performance, or spending that may impact IT or the wider business.

Vendor Performance Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track and analyze supplier performance using Excel and dashboard reporting tools.
  • Monitor user access and IT licenses, ensuring timely deactivation of unused accounts.

Security & Awareness

  • Lead the implementation and maintenance of relevant procurement and supplier management policies and standard operating procedures in line with ISO27001 requirements.
  • Develop and maintain training materials for the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and requirements of ISO27001 pertaining to supplier onboarding, management and review.

Innovation & Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to promote innovation within the technology ecosystem.
  • Communicate relevant technology and security updates to the business to drive adoption and best practices.
  • Collaborate with the Quality Dept on matters relating to ISO27001 compliance and opportunities for improvement, such as those identified through internal audits and supplier performance review.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Proven experience in IT administration, vendor management, or procurement support.
  • Experience with contract negotiation and supplier onboarding.
  • Strong understanding of IT compliance frameworks, particularly ISO27001.
  • Proficiency in Excel and dashboard reporting tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to problem‑solving.

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World‑class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work‑life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real‑time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes, such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

title: Senior Director, Nature Fund Advisory
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is based in Arlington, VA, Colombia, Peru, or Brazil and offers remote or hybrid work flexibility. Amid growing consensus that the protection, restoration, and improved management of ecosystems can provide at least 30% of the climate mitigation needed to limit warming to 1.5 °C, CI has set ambitious targets to realize the potential of Natural Climate Solutions (NCS). A key mechanism for unlocking this potential is driving investments to NCS projects that generate meaningful climate impact and financial returns, including improved forest management of working natural and plantation forests (climate‑smart forestry; CSF) and other NCS types.

The Nature Fund Advisory team acts as impact advisors to private and public investors looking to deploy return‑seeking capital into NCS projects in ways that deliver tangible climate, community, and ecological outcomes. The team establishes ESG and impact criteria, conducts due diligence on potential investments, and carries out annual impact monitoring for our client partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate and project manage a cross‑divisional team with expertise in NCS, ESG, carbon, monitoring, finance, and other relevant skills to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Oversee the delivery of high‑quality due diligence results and related investment memos in coordination with partners.
  • Define functional processes, protocols, and formats, and continually iterate fund‑ and project‑level best practices to ensure robust due diligence and underwriting that results in an accurate understanding of the risks and opportunities presented by diverse investment opportunities, and promotes CI’s objectives of driving resources to high‑quality NCS with speed and scale.
  • Provide investment recommendations to CI’s investment committee representative, in cases where CI participates in fund governance.
  • Develop program strategies, objectives, work plans, and performance metrics.
  • Monitor, measure, interpret, and share results on a regular basis.
  • Develop a cadre of qualified third‑party professionals with the appropriate, field‑tested experience to conduct accurate due diligence on innovative forest management systems in challenging contexts worldwide.
  • Directly oversee and ensure program compliance with CI policies, funding agreements, and local requirements.
  • Articulate needs for technical capacity and manage, resource, and recruit the team as necessary to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Position CI as a recognized and sought‑after subject‑matter expert.
  • Hold conferences and learning events to share CI’s expertise, best practices, and amplify success with key audiences.
  • Serve as a trusted and visible point of contact for CI.
  • Champion opportunities for program and staff growth and development.

Support fundraising and external engagement

  • Support the development of major public (GEF, GCF) fundraising proposals and advise on public funding programs with substantial return‑seeking NBS project components.
  • Provide strategic thought leadership, including engagement at international forums, engagement with government, and serving as an external spokesperson for CI.
  • Develop and maintain high‑level relationships with key external partners, including NGOs, local communities, and private developers; identify and engage a network of forestry and agricultural companies, technical partners, and local and international NGOs; facilitate monitoring and verification, high‑quality technical standards, and appropriate community engagement and other safeguards that contribute to a robust NCS investment framework.

People and Resource Management Responsibilities

  • Directly supervise program and project staff, including overseeing the work of external partners.
  • Manage proposals and budgets, and ensure that activities performed by team staff are compensated in budgets with funds and partners.
  • Ensure compliance with donor requirements and CI policies.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This is a full‑time position.
  • Local and/or international travel of 30% or more, often to remote locations and in difficult travel and working conditions.
  • Flexibility in work schedule required to accommodate time‑zone differences between the Arlington, VA office, and international field offices located in Europe, Asia‑Pacific, Africa, and Latin America.
  • Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in forestry, ecosystem management, environmental science, or another relevant field.
  • 10 or more years of professional experience, including program and project management experience, and 5 or more years supervising multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of forestry and other nature‑based climate solutions.
  • Experience with sustainability and environmental programs and certification standards that address carbon, energy, water, biodiversity, social, and sustainable forest management, e.g., Forest Stewardship Certification (FSC), Verified Carbon Standard (VCS), Gold Standard, Climate Community and Biodiversity (CCB).
  • Demonstrated experience with carbon standards for ARR and REDD+ projects, e.g., VCS, Goldstandard, Art Trees.
  • Knowledge of international climate mitigation policies and programs, e.g. Paris Agreement, the Kyoto Protocol, the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).
  • Expertise and understanding of proper management of greenfield and brownfield forestry and other NCS investments.
  • Evidence of a focus on collaboration and a strong network of individuals and institutions in NCS and forestry, including experience in convening and coordinating a broad range of individuals.
  • Experience with social and environmental safeguards and their application in the forestry sector.
  • Demonstrated track record of working effectively with multicultural, multidisciplinary teams to produce concrete results, including a strong capacity to navigate diversity, equity, and inclusion challenges and opportunities.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong and positive relationships across the organization.
  • Ability to manage and organize multiple projects with competing priorities and different timelines.
  • Excellent oral and written skills in English.
  • Superb technical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail, commitment to delivering products to exacting quality standards, organization, and time management skills.
  • Proven leadership skills and success in effectively inspiring and engaging diverse work groups in a multicultural environment.
  • Proven ability to multitask, meet priorities, and work in a fast‑paced environment with changing priorities with limited supervision.
  • Clear understanding of when and how to involve leadership and other programs to resolve challenges and achieve results.

Preferred

  • Graduate degree.
  • Ability to communicate in any one of the following: Spanish, Portuguese, French, Bahasa, or Mandarin.

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.

Conservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.

Paid Search Marketing Manager

We’re currently hiring a Paid Search Marketing Manager to join our growing remote team.

As an integral part of our marketing team, you will be responsible for managing, optimizing, and growing our search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across Google Ads, Bing Ads, and other platforms.


Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we’re transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we’re investing in the next generation of our platform—and we’re looking for a Paid Search Marketing Manager to help drive it.

See what we’re building

Responsibilities:

Campaign Management & Optimization

  • Manage and optimize large-scale, complex SEM campaigns across Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta Ads and other search platforms.
  • Activate, optimize and make efficient Local Services Ads (LSA) at scale.
  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance, adjusting bids, bid strategies, budgets, and ad copy to maximize ROI.
  • Continuously test and refine ad creatives, landing pages, and audience/location targeting to improve click through rates and conversion rates.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Leverage Google Analytics and other analytic and visualization tools to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and generate actionable insights. Summarize KPIs against targets and provide actionable recommendations for optimization and improvement.
  • Conduct deep-dive analysis to understand customer behavior, keyword trends, and competitive landscape.

Keyword, Audience & Campaign Strategy

  • Research and identify new keyword opportunities to expand our reach.
  • Implement audience segmentation strategies to improve targeting and efficiency.

  • Execute campaign type strategies that provide max conversion contribution at targeted customer acquisition costs; RSA, DSA, PMax, AI Search Max placements, audiences and more.

Budget & Bid Strategy

  • Utilize automated bidding strategies and manual adjustments to improve ad performance.

Our Vision

Building the world’s leaders of tomorrow.

Designing the education system for the 22nd century.

About Delta Institute

Delta Institute is part of the Crimson ecosystem and focuses on delivering high-impact, future-facing learning experiences that help students stand out globally. Our programs sit at the intersection of education, industry, and innovation.

Through cohort-based programs and global partnerships, we give high school students access to hands‑on, real‑world learning experiences across industries such as technology, consulting, law, finance, design, and entrepreneurship.

The Role

As an Senior Operations Associate , Delta Careers, you are a core owner of program delivery and experience quality. You ensure that complex, multi‑stakeholder programs run smoothly and feel seamless to students, mentors, and partners.

This is not a back‑office role. You will sit at the center of program execution, working closely with mentors, program coordinators, internal teams, and external partners to deliver consistently high‑quality experiences at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, problem‑solving, and making systems work better over time.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Program Ownership & Delivery

  • Own the operational execution of Delta Careers programs from start to finish.
  • Translate program goals into clear timelines, workflows, and day‑to‑day execution plans.
  • Ensure programs are delivered smoothly, on time, and to a high standard—even when conditions change.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Act as the primary operational point of contact for mentors, program coordinators, and internal stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships with mentors and partners through clear communication and reliability.
  • Support program coordinators with guidance, alignment, and escalation handling when needed.

Quality, Judgment & Issue Resolution

  • Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, or gaps before they escalated.

Continuous Improvement

  • Capture feedback, insights, and learnings from each program cycle.
  • Contribute to improving systems, templates, and processes so programs become more efficient and scalable over time.
  • Share program highlights, testimonials, and insights with internal teams to support broader impact.

Minimum Requirements

Who This Role Is For

  • Experience in program operations, project management, education, or coordination‑heavy roles.
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple moving parts at once.
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast‑paced, remote or distributed environment.

Ideal Attributes

  • High ownership mindset: you naturally take responsibility and see things through.
  • Strong problem‑solving instincts and comfort with ambiguity.
  • Thoughtful, people‑centered approach when working with students, mentors, and colleagues.
  • Interest in building systems, not just executing tasks.
  • Calm under pressure and confident handling complex situations.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

  • Programs consistently run smoothly with minimal escalations.
  • Students, mentors, and partners report a positive, well‑supported experience.
  • Issues are anticipated and resolved proactively rather than reactively.
  • Internal teams trust you as a reliable owner of program execution.
  • Feedback and insights lead to visible improvements in how programs operate.
  • Program operations feel organized, clear, and scalable.

Why Work at Delta Institute

  • A fast‑growing, global organization with meaningful ownership from day one.
  • Flexible working environment with autonomy over how you work.
  • Strong internal mobility, many roles are filled through internal growth.
  • Annual individual training budget to support your development.

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. “Get Shit Done.”

Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.

Accountable for:

  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.

Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.

Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. In Agoda’s Back End Engineering department, we build scalable, fault‑tolerant systems and APIs that host our core business logic. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, and more. These mission‑critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we employ state‑of‑the‑art CI/CD and testing techniques to ensure everything works without downtime. We use languages like Scala and Go, data technologies like Kafka and Aerospike, and agile development practices. title: Senior R&D Manager
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

Ideal role for an experienced & ambitious scientist within agronomy. As our Senior Research and Development (R&D) Manager you will lead and be responsible for managing our research and development programme relating to deployment of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a carbon dioxide removal technique in Brazil, with a special focus on agronomic trials. You will design, manage and interpret data from experiments in order to effectively monitor agronomic parameters and as well as helping to address fundamental research questions relating to ERW. You will be based in Brazil, with presence onsite at various locations within Brazil when necessary.

The Impact you can make

This role will oversee and manage team members, and you will take ownership over experiments, driving forward our scientific strategy. You lead our reporting on farmer co-benefits and impact metrics, providing robust scientific evidence to support the case for our wider impact. You will play a key role in managing and driving our science strategy and will be expected to maintain and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Core working relationships

Reporting to the VP of Science and Research, you will support and work effectively with all members of the science and operations teams. You will lead and work closely with our Science and Impact Lead and our Agronomic R&D Lead.

Key Responsibilities

  • Management of team members within our agronomy R+D programme
  • Overseeing and planning our agronomy R+D programme, such as the design of experiments and communication with external stakeholders
  • Generating, analysing, presenting, and publishing data from experiments and deployments to wide-ranging and high-profile audiences
  • You will support operations to provide the robust scientific evidence for our farmer pitches and case studies
  • You drive research and the wider science team strategy
  • You manage communications and partnerships with leading researchers globally, with a specific focus on Brazil
  • You will work with flexibility in Brazil, with travel to onsite experiments within Brazil and to visit partners (expectation & benefit)

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • You are an experienced senior scientist with a PhD (or equivalent experience) in Plant Science, Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry or related fields
  • You have, ideally, 5+ years of experience in senior research or research related roles
  • You have extensive experience in research and development and experimental design, with a focus on agronomy or a related field
  • You have a proven track record of previously successful research projects and publications in high quality journals
  • You have worked on successful research projects with a wide range of stakeholders and partners, e.g., from industry, government and academia.
  • You have knowledge of agronomy and agronomic trials
  • You are fluent in Portuguese
  • You have advanced English language skills
  • You are based in Brazil (ideally Piracicaba or Sao Paulo region)

Salesforce Engineering Manager – Remote (LATAM)

Why This Role Matters

At Greenbox Capital, we help small businesses thrive by giving them fast, accessible funding. As the Salesforce Engineering Manager, you’re the kind of leader who loves building, shaping, and leveling up a high-impact engineering team. In this role, you’ll guide a tight-knit group of Salesforce developers and QA engineers as you design, build, and deliver the next evolution of Greenbox’s Salesforce-powered MCA platform. This is a hands‑on leadership role combining Salesforce development, architecture ownership, and people leadership for a small team.

As a Salesforce Engineering Manager, you bring deep technical expertise and a steady leadership presence. You know how to inspire strong engineering habits, champion scalable architecture, and keep quality front and center as your team ships meaningful, well‑crafted solutions that power critical areas of the business.

You’ll be hands‑on when it counts—setting standards, jumping into complex design work, and driving continuous improvement across coding, testing, and release practices. At the same time, you’ll help define the future of the platform by partnering closely with product owners, architects, and technology leadership to align technical strategy with fast‑moving business needs.

If you thrive in environments where you can build, coach, innovate, and elevate—this is your kind of opportunity.

What Success Looks Like

  • Reliability: You consistently deliver complete, functional solutions on time, keeping projects moving and stakeholders confident in the team’s output.
  • Efficiency: Your estimates are accurate, priorities are clear, and the team’s overall speed improves because you help remove roadblocks and keep work flowing.
  • Quality: Releases are smoother, deployments succeed more often, and production defects decline because you prioritize clean architecture, testing, and long‑term maintainability.

What You’ll Do

Leadership & Management

  • Manage a small team of Salesforce developers, QA engineers, and administrators, providing direction, coaching, and performance feedback
  • Define and enforce development standards, coding conventions, and review processes to maintain a consistent, high‑quality codebase
  • Own team performance metrics, including velocity, quality, and release predictability
  • Partner with product and technology leadership to prioritize and plan work aligned to business goals
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the team

Technical Ownership

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enhancements to Greenbox’s custom Salesforce platform for MCA loan origination, underwriting, and servicing
  • Serve as a technical contributor in complex design and coding efforts (Apex, LWC, and API integrations)
  • Oversee system stability, data integrity, and performance tuning, ensuring uptime and scalability for mission‑critical workflows
  • Partner with architects and DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines, ensure high test coverage, and enforce deployment validation standards
  • Drive adoption of best practices for automated testing, version control, and secure, compliant development

Cross‑functional Collaboration

  • Work with business stakeholders to translate fintech and MCA requirements into scalable technical solutions
  • Collaborate with Data and Platform Engineering teams to ensure consistent integration patterns between Salesforce, Fundingo, and external systems (banking, payment, and document services)
  • Act as the technical escalation point for complex incidents, root‑cause analysis, and production troubleshooting
  • Demonstrate the ability to lead teams through technical change, coach engineers, and manage delivery timelines
  • Have high emotional intelligence and proven ability to lead, influence, and collaborate across teams in a remote environment
  • Have strong interpersonal and communication skills (English), with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences
  • Foster autonomy and high performance within the team while maintaining technical rigor

What You’ve Done Before

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field required
  • 7 + years of Salesforce development and administration experience, including 2+ years leading or managing an engineering team
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data architecture for lending and financial workflows (loans, renewals, underwriting, collections)
  • Proven success in multi‑cloud Salesforce implementations (Sales, Service, Experience)
  • Deep understanding of MCA or alternative lending operations. Experience with lending/fintech Salesforce packages strongly preferred

Tools And Expertise You’ll Bring

  • Deep expertise in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, and Salesforce APIs, SOQL
  • Experience with CI/CD, Git, Azure DevOps, and automated testing frameworks
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps for agile planning and reporting
  • The ability to write and speak in English at a professional level
  • Familiarity with event‑driven architectures and asynchronous processing for high‑volume transactions

What to Expect from Our Interview Process

We believe in a respectful, efficient, and transparent hiring experience. Here’s what you can expect:

Step 1:

Initial Phone Screen (30 minutes)

A brief conversation with a recruiter to learn more about your background, interests, and alignment with the role.

Step 2:

Hiring Manager Interview (1 hour)

A deeper discussion about the role, your relevant experience, and how you’d contribute to the team.

Step 3:

Role‑Specific Assessment or Panel Interview (1 hour)

Depending on the role, this may include a DiSC assessment, take‑home assignment, technical interview, or live case study with team members.

Step 4:

Final Interview or Leadership Chat (1 hour)

A final conversation with senior leadership or cross‑functional team members to ensure alignment with our mission and values.

Competitive Pay – We know your worth and we pay accordingly.

Flexible PTO – Work hard, rest well. Take the time you need to recharge.

Remote – Fully remote within the U.S., working Eastern Time hours to keep everyone aligned.

This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure / Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics / model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture / engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;

Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL / SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST / SOAP / Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands‑on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large‑scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud / Data 360 to external systems (Azure / Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and / or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum teams;

Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and / or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;

Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI / CD).

  • Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;

  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);

  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;
  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;

  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Técnico em Meio Ambiente . O profissional será inserido em projeto de eficiência energética, cuja lógica é a de troca de resíduos recicláveis por bônus na fatura de energia elétrica. title: Oficial Eletricista
description:
DESCRIÇÃO

Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de INSTALAÇÕES, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras tarefas, visando o atendimento às necessidades do Contrato; Executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de MÁQUINAS E EQUIPAMENTOS (Aparelhos e equipamentos hospitalares, Back Lights, Postes de Iluminação, Boilers, Bombas hidráulicas, Tele Tubos, máquinas de lavar louça, cafeteiras, liquidificadores, fornos, etc.), lubrificando peças e trocando circuitos, comandos e motores, a fim de possibilitar o pleno funcionamento da infra‑estrutura do Contrato; Executar a manutenção preventiva de QUADROS ELÉTRICOS de BAIXA Tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica através de aparelho Multiteste, limpando componentes com a utilização de produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infra‑estrutura do Contrato; Realizar operações em LINHAS DE ALTA TENSÃO no caso de queda de energia e mediante autorização da Light, efetuando manobras e transferências de ramais de acordo com os equipamentos e procedimentos de segurança requeridos, a fim de possibilitar a religação da força necessária ao atendimento das necessidades do Contrato; Executar a manutenção preventiva de NO BREAK, efetuando a leitura de parâmetros e a medição de corrente elétrica, reapertando peças, limpando componentes e trocando baterias, a fim de manter as condições de operacionalidade requeridas; Executar a manutenção preventiva de SUBESTAÇÕES, limpando componentes, reapertando e lubrificando peças, medindo a voltagem de baterias, trocando fusíveis, verificando o funcionamento de quadro de capacitores, nível de óleo combustível e lubrificante de motores e estado de conservação de correias e mangueiras, bem como, inspecionando ruídos, aquecimentos e outras anormalidades, a fim de propiciar o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos e infra‑estrutura do Contrato; Operar Subestações no caso de falta de energia elétrica, acompanhando a ligação automática do equipamento e desligando o Gerador no restabelecimento da força, visando o pleno fornecimento de energia para máquinas e instalações do Contrato; Efetuar a manutenção preventiva de TRANSFORMADORES, reapertando e lubrificando peças; Efetuar a leitura de plantas, desenhos e diagramas elétricos; Emitir formulário específico (Laudo), detalhando tipos de problemas, setores, equipamentos e outras informações referentes aos serviços executados, para fins de controle e informação à Chefia; Efetuar anotações em Livro de Ocorrências, indicando os eventos ocorridos, serviços executados, horários, datas e outras informações pertinentes, a fim de possibilitar o controle dos serviços de manutenção; Atuar em outras especialidades de manutenção elétrica conforme a necessidade. Orientar os demais profissionais da equipe, dirimindo dúvidas e indicando procedimentos, a fim de agilizar os trabalhos de manutenção.

title: Oficial Eletricista - RJ
description:
Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de INSTALAÇÕES, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras tarefas, visando o atendimento às necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de MÁQUINAS E EQUIPAMENTOS (Aparelhos e equipamentos hospitalares, Back Lights, Postes de Iluminação, Boilers, Bombas hidráulicas, Tele Tubos, máquinas de lavar louça, cafeteiras, liquidificadores, fornos, etc.), lubrificando peças e trocando circuitos, comandos e motores, a fim de possibilitar o pleno funcionamento da infra‑estrutura do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de QUADROS ELÉTRICOS de BAIXA Tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica através de aparelho Multiteste, limpando componentes com a utilização de produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infra‑estrutura do Contrato. Realizar operações em LINHAS DE ALTA TENSÃO no caso de queda de energia e mediante autorização da Light, efetuando manobras e transferências de ramais de acordo com os equipamentos e procedimentos de segurança requeridos, a fim de possibilitar a religação da força necessária ao atendimento das necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de NO BREAK, efetuando a leitura de parâmetros e a medição de corrente elétrica, reapertando peças, limpando componentes e trocando baterias, a fim de manter as condições de operacionalidade requeridas. Executar a manutenção preventiva de SUBESTAÇÕES, limpando componentes, reapertando e lubrificando peças, medindo a voltagem de baterias, trocando fusíveis, verificando o funcionamento de quadro de capacitores, nível de óleo combustível e lubrificante de motores e estado de conservação de correias e mangueiras, bem como, inspecionando ruídos, aquecimentos e outras anormalidades, a fim de propiciar o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos e infra‑estrutura do Contrato. Operar Subestações no caso de falta de energia elétrica, acompanhando a ligação automática do equipamento e desligando o Gerador no restabelecimento da força, visando o pleno fornecimento de energia para máquinas e instalações do Contrato. Efetuar a manutenção preventiva de TRANSFORMADORES, reapertando e lubrificando peças. Efetuar a leitura de plantas, desenhos e diagramas elétricos. Emitir formulário específico (Laudo), detalhando tipos de problemas, setores, equipamentos e outras informações referentes aos serviços executados, para fins de controle e informação à Chefia. Efetuar anotações em Livro de Ocorrências, indicando os eventos ocorridos, serviços executados, horários, datas e outras informações pertinentes, a fim de possibilitar o controle dos serviços de manutenção. Atuar em outras especialidades de manutenção elétrica conforme a necessidade. Orientar os demais profissionais da equipe, dirimindo dúvidas e indicando procedimentos, a fim de agilizar os trabalhos de manutenção.

O trabalho envolve monitoramento de mercado, definição de direcionamentos estratégicos e colaboração contínua com equipes internas e parceiros externos, assegurando que cada lançamento seja conduzido com consistência, eficiência e visão de longo prazo.

Diversidade :

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Acreditamos na intencionalidade para gerar movimentos transformadores, que reconheçam que diferentes grupos sociais partem de diferentes realidades que precisam ser levadas em consideração e acolhidas pelas pessoas e pelo negócio.

Equipes representativas trazem inovação inclusiva, nos permitindo criar experiências emocionantes para diferentes tipos de pessoas.

Queremos ser cada vez mais o lugar onde todas as pessoas se encontram e, por isso, essa vaga é para você, pessoa com deficiência , que quer crescer e construir o futuro com a gente, nos bastidores de produtos e serviços que impactam a vida de milhões de brasileiros e brasileiras todos os dias.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver briefings completos, estratégicos e estruturados, capazes de orientar equipes internas de criação, mídia, social e demais áreas de marketing. Isso inclui traduzir necessidades de negócio em objetivos de comunicação, definir públicos-alvo, proposta de valor, entregáveis esperados, prazos, indicadores de sucesso e alinhamento com a estratégia geral do produto;
  • Desenvolver os planos de marketing e comunicação dos produtos;
  • Acompanhar KPIs e métricas-chave das campanhas (awareness, performance, conversão, ROI), analisar dados e comportamentos do público, identificar aprendizados relevantes e propor otimizações contínuas. Transformar números em recomendações acionáveis, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas e aprimoramento das próximas iniciativas;
  • Pesquisar e analisar o mercado, comportamentos de consumidores, movimentações de mercado e tendências. Avaliar dados setoriais, benchmarking e insights externos para embasar estratégias, identificar lacunas e antecipar oportunidades que fortaleçam a atuação da marca e dos produtos;

  • Atuar em parceria com áreas internas e parceiros externos para implementar ações de marketing que potencializem os objetivos estratégicos do negócio. Acompanhar entregas e cronogramas, facilitar alinhamentos e assegurar que todas as ações estejam conectadas a estratégia.

  • Graduação completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólido conhecimento em estratégias e planejamento de marketing;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados e métricas de desempenho (Google Analytics, dashboards, métricas de mídia, KPIs de campanha);
  • Conhecimentos em mídia digital e canais de comunicação (mídia paga, social, CRM, conteúdo);
  • Experiência prévia (entre 2–4 anos) em funções de marketing, preferencialmente atuando com campanhas, produtos ou projetos integrados;
  • Vivência na condução e acompanhamento de campanhas do início ao fim — briefing, execução e análise de resultados;
  • Experiência trabalhando em parceria com áreas internas, stakeholders e fornecedores externos (agências, produtoras, veículos etc.);
  • Histórico de gerar insights a partir de dados e propor otimizações ou novas abordagens estratégicas;

  • Proatividade e Autonomia: postura ativa para antecipar necessidades, buscar informações, resolver problemas e propor melhorias sem depender de orientação constante.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Excelência na criação de apresentações em PowerPoint, com forte capacidade de estruturar narrativas claras e visualmente atraentes. Inclui domínio de design de slides, organização lógica do storytelling e capacidade de sintetizar informações complexas de forma simples e envolvente;

Desenvolvimento de soluções automatizadas para otimizar a gestão de dados

  • Acompanhar o programa de inovação da afiliada e o desenvolvimento de projetos OBO conforme as necessidades dos ativos.
  • Responsável por projetar, implementar e manter a arquitetura Lakehouse de dados, garantindo escalabilidade e desempenho alinhados às necessidades dos ativos.

  • Desenvolver ferramentas para a equipe de Suporte Técnico OBO.
  • Identificar requisitos para projetos de inovação, recomendar soluções digitais e implementar metodologias avançadas para melhorar a análise e interpretação de dados.

  • Criar ferramentas para automatizar coleta de dados, melhorar o controle de qualidade e desenvolver dashboards para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Suporte ao Monitoramento e Gestão de Reservatórios

  • Realizar o controle de qualidade dos dados, formatação e carregamento na base dados PI dos ativos não operados. Atuar proativamente na identificação e resolução de quaisquer problemas que possam surgir.
  • Suporte ao monitoramento de reservatórios por meio da automação dos fluxos de carregamento de dados e da melhoria dos painéis de produção (T-MORE/Power BI).
  • Manter fluxos de trabalho ETL automatizados.
  • Integrar e pré-processar dados diversos (relatórios de produção, dados de poços e topside) para garantir consistência e qualidade.
  • Suporte a Gestão de Reservatórios no desenvolvimento de ferramentas digitais, incluindo abordagens automatizadas com ciência de dados e dashboards, para formalizar metodologias e fluxos de trabalho aplicáveis a toda a afiliada, além de ferramentas de previsão de produção de curto prazo.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com geocientistas, engenheiros e outras partes interessadas para fornecer soluções baseadas em dados.

Manter contato com especialistas da matriz e garantir comunicação eficiente sobre serviços e aplicações fornecidos por HQ.

Responsabilidades

  • Ser o principal ponto de contato para projetos de ciência de dados e automação na Gestão de Ativos, colaborando com TI, Inovação e HQ.

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e promoção de soluções automatizadas para processos de gestão de dados.
  • Demonstrar proatividade e construir relações sólidas com stakeholders para garantir execução eficaz dos projetos.

Profil du candidat

  • Graduação/Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Mais de 8 anos de experiência em ciência de dados e engenharia de dados, com foco em tecnologias Lakehouse e frameworks de processamento de big data (Apache Spark).
  • Familiaridade com gerenciamento de banco de dados, ferramentas ETL e orquestração de pipelines de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python, Java, Scala e SQL.
  • Experiência prévia com dados de Reservatórios/Produção, PI; OFM/Spotfire é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de vida básico do negócio de E&P (Exploração & Produção) de petróleo e gás.
  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas, com capacidade eficiente de solucionar questões de dados.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; francês é um diferencial.
  • Boas habilidades interpessoais, de comunicação e iniciativa.

  • Controle de Estoque: Acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.
  • Sugestão de Transferências: realizar sugestão de transferência de mercadoria do Centro de Distribuição (CD) para as lojas.

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).

Sobre nós

Somos a maior fabricante de equipamentos de videocirurgia do Brasil com matriz e fábrica no Rio de Janeiro, escritório em São Paulo, Ceará e representação comercial em todo o país. Com mais de 23 anos de história, já instalamos mais de 10.000 equipamentos em todas as regiões do Brasil, conquistando a confiança de nossos clientes e levando cada vez mais inovação, segurança e qualidade para o mercado de saúde.

Cada videocirurgia realizada = menos uma cicatriz de cirurgia aberta no mundo.

É isso que nos move e nos faz ir além, todos os dias!

Seja um Confiante e faça parte do nosso time!

description:
Descrição da vaga

Conhecendo um pouco mais sobre o grupo Limppano S/A. Conhecendo um pouco mais sobre o grupo Limppano S/A. Somos um time que Cuidamos da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, no qual combinamos determinação e comprometimento para entregarmos produtos de qualidade. Entendemos que para obtermos os melhores resultados, precisamos dos melhores profissionais. Estamos à procura de talentos que sejam criativos, inovadores e ousados na busca por conhecimento, que tragam resultados sustentáveis ao Grupo Limppano.

Se você tem prazer em contribuir, gosta do que faz, e é focado em resultados essa VAGA é para VOCÊ!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Reposição de Produtos: abastecer o ponto natural da categoria (gôndolas) e pontos extras negociados ou conquistados (ilhas, terminais, pontas de gôndolas, “orelhas”, entre outros) de acordo com as diretrizes da Limppano, evitando rupturas e respeitando o FIFO (primeiro que vence é o primeiro que sai).
  • Exposição e Organização: garantir que os produtos estejam organizados e alinhados com o planograma da empresa.
  • Montagem de Pontos Extras: instalar materiais promocionais (MPDV) e montar exposições sazonais, campanhas e ações promocionais.
  • Precificação: verificar e corrigir preços nos produtos e nas gôndolas conforme as informações da loja ou da empresa. Implementar as etiquetas de preços no PDV.
  • Controle de Estoque: Acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.
  • Sugestão de Transferências: realizar sugestão de transferência de mercadoria do Centro de Distribuição (CD) para as lojas.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).
  • Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.

Condições de Trabalho:

  • Atuação externa com visitas a diferentes PDVs diariamente, seguindo a sistemática pré-determinada.
  • Trabalho físico leve a moderado (carga, movimentação e organização de produtos).
  • Eventual necessidade de deslocamento entre cidades da região.

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Estagiário

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR) .

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Senior Reservoir Engineer
description:
Galp has been part of society for generations, and as energy changes, we adapt too. Here you will have the opportunity to grow, with the resources you need to develop at your own pace, in your own way. Together we can continue to contribute to the communities where we live and work. We can build a more efficient future for ourselves and for future generations. We're counting on your energy ⚡

Bring your curiosity and passion into action. Join Galp today

You will join the Upstream business unit that develops a competitive and unique portfolio in the sector, with a carbon intensity well below the industry average. It comprises projects at different stages of maturity, from exploration to production. In addition to promising assets in Namibia and São Tomé and Príncipe, the portfolio includes one of the largest oil and natural gas discoveries of recent decades: in the pre-salt Santos basin in Brazil.

About your future Team

You'll be joining Reservoir Engineering Team, sharing their mission to deliver decision-ready, high-quality reservoir engineering analyses that directly influence asset development, reserves maturation, and production optimization, while acting as a technical reference within the RE team and across upstream disciplines.

How will your day-to-day look like:

  • Compressively and independently manage reservoir engineering discipline scopes across multiple assets, with business focus;
  • Own and deliver reservoir engineering studies for assigned assets across the asset life cycle;
  • Build, maintain, and quality-control dynamic reservoir models and associated forecasts;
  • Provide clear, structured, and decision-oriented recommendations to Asset Teams and management;
  • Act as technical authority for reservoir engineering studies within assigned assets;
  • Ensure technical consistency, robustness, and full traceability of assumptions, methodologies, and results;
  • Proactively identify value opportunities (production acceleration, recovery improvement, risk reduction);
  • Support mentoring and technical development of junior reservoir engineers;
  • Support new business opportunities screening, review, and technical assurance;
  • Act as a key integration pivot of critical decision making disciplines and scopes;
  • Lead and/or support R&D initiatives.

What makes you unique:

  • Advanced dynamic simulation capability (history matching and forecasting) using Eclipse and Intersect;
  • Proven experience influencing well testing, well completion, development concepts, well phasing, and production strategies;
  • Reservoir engineering studies execution, including integration of well test data into forecasts and simulations;
  • Reserves and Resources classification expertise;
  • Uncertainty framing and scenario-based decision support;
  • Ability to translate complex technical work into clear business implications;
  • Strong cross-disciplinary integration (geology, petrophysics, production, facilities);
  • Structured problem solving and analytical rigour;
  • Proactive, independent and integrative mindset.

Additional benefits

  • An energy company integrated in the energy sector where you can make a difference;
  • Competitive salary and bonus;
  • Health insurance for you and your family;

At Galp, we have the ambition to be a Human Centered Company, and for that we acknowledge our responsibility to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) by having a genuine mindset, lived on our day-to-day, in all our processes. We believe that everyone should be celebrated and valued for who they are: not only for their potential, but also for their distinctive characteristics.

EFY is a fast-growing fintech company building the future of payments and financial operations. We are a compliance-driven, customer-obsessed, and data-led organization.

Locations

This position is open to candidates located in the following countries and cities:

  • Colombia (1): Bogotá or Medellín or Barranquilla
  • Brazil (1): São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro, or another major trade hub
  • Mexico (1): Mexico City (CDMX) or Monterrey or Guadalajara

Country Manager with full commercial, regulatory, and structural ownership.

To build and lead EFY Finance’s operation in Colombia / Mexico / Brazil as the dominant platform for importers and exporters, positioning EFY as:

  • FX regulatory classification
  • Trade declarations and usage

  • Prevent fiscal or FX regulatory risk for both EFY and clients:
  • Block or redesign high-risk operations
  • Ensure full documentation and traceability
  • D. Strategic Relationship Management
  • Build and manage senior-level relationships with:
  • FX intermediaries (IMCs)
  • Banks (trade, treasury, correspondent teams)
  • Customs agencies and logistics operators
  • Tax and legal advisory firms
  • Trade associations and chambers
  • Position EFY as an institutional, compliant player — not an informal fintech
  • Represent EFY in key industry forums and protect brand reputation

Required Education & Professional Background

  • Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Law, or related fields
  • Postgraduate studies (preferred) in Finance, Banking, International Trade, Economics, or Business Management
  • Certifications (plus) in FX, Trade Finance, Treasury, Risk Management, Compliance, or Financial Regulation
  • Evidence of continuous professional development in:
  • Local FX regulation
  • International trade
  • Corporate FX
  • Financial infrastructure innovation (fintech, alternative rails, stablecoins)
  • Required Experience
  • Minimum 10–15 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • Corporate banking and/or FX desk (ideally focused on corporate clients, trade finance, and FX)
  • Regulated FX intermediaries (IMCs) with focus on international trade and corporate clients
  • Trade finance and/or corporate FX (onshore or offshore)
  • Proven leadership of senior commercial teams (not retail or junior-only teams)
  • Demonstrated exposure to large import/export clients (major corporations, economic groups, multinational companies)
  • Strong sales skills

Languages

  • Spanish-speaking countries:
  • Spanish: Native or fluent
  • English: B2+ or higher (required)
  • Brazil:
  • Portuguese: Native or fluent
  • English: B2+ or higher (required)

Soft Skills We Value

  • Immediate technical credibility with CFOs, finance managers, and heads of foreign trade
  • Clear, structured communication with senior executives and operational teams
  • Strong ability to educate and advise clients, not just sell a solution
  • Non-aggressive closing style, grounded in technical arguments, risk awareness, and real client value
  • High ethical standards and regulatory rigor; never proposes shortcuts or questionable structures
  • Ability to move seamlessly between technical depth and executive-level narrative, effectively speaking both “bank language” and “business language”

Why Join EFY?

  • Exposure to fintech, crypto, and cross-border payments
  • Fast-paced, results-oriented environment with real growth opportunities
  • Continuous learning in consultative B2B sales and financial products
  • Regional scope with multicultural teams
  • Competitive compensation with commissions

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. description:
You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions.   • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.

  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.
